question: Can word representations that are learned functions of a pretrained deep bidirectional language model's internal states capture both syntax/semantics and polysemy, and improve many NLP tasks?
hypothesis: Exposing all internal biLM layers lets downstream models mix different semi-supervision signals and beats using only the top layer.
contributions: ELMo: task-specific linear combination of all biLM layers
State of the art on six NLP tasks with 6-20% relative error reductions as stated
Analysis showing lower layers capture syntax, higher layers semantics, and that all layers help

method.summary: A 2-layer character-CNN biLSTM language model is pretrained on the 1B Word Benchmark, frozen, and its layers are combined with learned softmax weights and a scalar and concatenated into existing task models for six tasks.
method.task: contextual word representations via biLM pretraining, evaluated on SQuAD, SNLI, SRL, coreference, NER, SST-5

datasets.name: SQuAD
datasets.split: test for Table 1, dev for ablations

models.name: ELMo biLM
models.architecture: character-CNN input, 2-layer biLSTM LM with residual connection from layer 1 to 2, tied token and softmax parameters across directions

other.char_cnn: 2048 character n-gram convolutional filters, two highway layers, linear projection to 512
other.derived_from: halved all embedding and hidden dimensions of CNN-BIG-LSTM (Jozefowicz et al. 2016)

models.name: task baselines
models.architecture: Clark and Gardner 2017 (SQuAD), ESIM (SNLI), He et al. 2017 re-implementation (SRL), Lee et al. 2017 (Coref), biLSTM-CRF (NER), BCN (SST-5)

training.objective: joint maximisation of forward and backward LM log likelihood
training.dropout: a moderate amount of dropout on ELMo (value not given)
training.regularisation: optional lambda*||w||^2 on ELMo layer weights; lambda=1 or 0.001 compared
training.seeds: five seeds for SNLI, NER, SST-5

other.biLM_frozen_downstream: weights frozen when added to task model
other.biLM_finetuning: in most cases a biLM fine-tuned on domain data was used; details in supplemental material not in this PDF
other.layer_norm: in some cases layer normalization applied per biLM layer before weighting

inference.samples: five runs with different seeds for NER and SST-5 (mean and std); SNLI averaged over five seeds

parameters.ELMo_task_k: gamma_task * sum_j s_task_j h_k,j, s softmax normalised
parameters.placement: concatenate [x_k; ELMo] at input; also [h_k; ELMo] at output for SNLI and SQuAD

metrics.name: F1
metrics.definition: SQuAD, SRL, NER, WSD; average F1 for Coref

metrics.name: perplexity
metrics.definition: average of forward and backward biLM perplexity

eval.protocol: Test sets for Table 1 (mean and std over five seeds for NER and SST-5 because test sets are small); dev sets for ablations; no significance test stated.
